“The teacher has finally opened up the Seven Star Cave World.”

“When was the last time the teacher opened up the Seven Star Cave World?”

“I remember it was three hundred years ago.”

The twelve silhouettes were chatting with each other, all appearing quite leisurely.

Normally, these fellow disciples each had their own business to attend to, and it was rare for them to gather together like this.

“This time’s test has produced quite a few promising candidates, or else the teacher wouldn’t have opened the Seven Star Cave World.”

...

“They say there’s a member of the Tri-Eye Human Clan. If the eldest senior and the second and third seniors aren’t interested, then I’ll reserve that Tri-Eye Human in advance.”

“Hehehe, the Tri-Eye Clan holds a special status within the Human Alliance. To take a disciple from the Tri-Eye Clan is equivalent to forming a connection with other higher-rank members of their race. I want to compete for it, too…”

The twelve silhouettes all began to speak.

There were few Tri-Eye Clan members, but their talents were extremely powerful.

At present, the number of the Tri-Eye Clan within human civilization didn’t exceed a hundred thousand.

And they were scattered across various territories.

Therefore,

even without direct bloodline connections,

there was a peculiar sense of closeness between members of the Tri-Eye Clan.

It was like meeting fellow countrymen in a foreign land.

With the aptitude of the Tri-Eye Clan, it was easy for them to produce high-rank Evolvers.

Taking in a disciple from the Tri-Eye Clan was akin to establishing relations with these high-rank Evolvers.

It would make anything in the future negotiable.

Of course, even without this relationship,

The twelve silhouettes would still be very keen to take them in as disciples.

After all, their qualification was evident.

A member of the Tri-Eye Clan, with careful cultivation,

could easily step into the sixth rank.

“I’m not interested in the Tri-Eye Clan, but that Yin Ling is mine.”

At this moment, the foremost figure among them slowly spoke up.

Yin Ling was the woman with silver hair. The Chikun Star Lord had commented that her space talent was not bad, one of the three Red Patterns, the number one existence among the hundreds of thousands of Evolvers this time.

“Since the eldest senior has spoken, then she’s yours.”

“Yin Ling has considerable space talent. Only our eldest senior is capable of cultivating her.”

“Indeed, indeed…”

…

Having said that, the remaining eleven silhouettes began to discuss other Evolvers.

Among the hundreds of thousands of Evolvers, only the three with Red Patterns and a few with Gold Patterns were worth their active competition.

As for the rest of the Evolvers… they would wait until they made it to the Seventh Star Cave.

…

“So this is the First Star Cave?”

Lin Yuan began to observe his surroundings.

According to the information provided by Fang Qing, the First Star Cave’s test likely pertained to the physical body.

Of course, it wasn’t absolute, but if not the physical body, then it would be the soul, or perhaps mental consciousness, insight, and so on.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

Just as Lin Yuan was observing,

one Evolver after another was transported over from the White Jade Plaza.

Many Evolvers looked around nervously.

The nearby scenery wasn’t complicated, resembling a wilderness, with a black racetrack tens of miles wide in the middle.

Once all the Evolvers had arrived,

that towering figure appeared once again.

“The trial of the First Star Cave is very simple, just walk to the end of this black racetrack.”

The towering figure raised his hand, pointing to the black racetrack, “Within one month, as long as you reach the end, you can enter the Second Star Cave.”

After speaking, the towering figure vanished.

Instantly, the venue erupted into a huge commotion.

The problem wasn’t that the test was too difficult.

It was too simple.

The black racetrack was tens of miles wide and at most a hundred miles long.

Therefore, within a month, to walk a hundred miles.

Even an ordinary citizen could cover a hundred miles in just a day or two at most.

Let alone the lowest among those present were third-rank Evolvers.

“Reach the end point?”

Lin Yuan didn’t rush into action but stood still and observed.

He believed the test wouldn’t be so simple, as the elimination rate in the first trial of past Seven Star Cave Challenges was terrifyingly high.

“Let others go ahead and try first.”

Lin Yuan was in no hurry; one could stay in each star cave for a month.

Even if he lingered here for a month, there would be no impact as long as he entered the Second Star Cave at the last moment.

“Someone is bound to be too impatient.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept over the surroundings.

After just a short while, a few of the Silver Pattern Evolvers seemed to get restless.

Among the hundreds of thousands of Evolvers, the Silver Pattern Evolvers were the most numerous, with the Red Pattern and Gold Pattern Evolvers combined numbering a little over a hundred.

It was precisely for this reason that the Seven Star Cave Challenge was particularly stimulating for the Silver Pattern Evolvers.

Imagine that every Silver Pattern Evolver was among the top ten existences on their respective planets, esteemed and sought after by many forces.

But upon arriving in the Seven Star Cave World they found that there were more than a million others just like them.

This gap between their former and current perception made a minority of the Silver Pattern Evolvers undergo a change in mentality.

“Someone here wants to see just what’s so extraordinary about this Seven Star Cave Challenge.”

A burly man with a wild appearance strode forward.

As this burly man, who exuded a third-rank vibe, stepped out, over a million Evolvers turned their gaze on him.

“Damn, this pressure is pretty intense.”

The burly man began to sweat coldly on his forehead. Knowing that these millions of gazes came from third and fourth-rank Evolvers was no small matter.

Boom.

Under the watchful eyes of everyone,

the burly man stepped onto the black racetrack.

“Huh?”

There was a slight change in the burly man’s expression.

He then took another step.

Two steps.

Five steps.

…

After covering about a hundred meters,

the burly man finally stopped.

“It’s gravity.”

“As soon as you enter into the area of the black racetrack, you’re placed in a gravitational field.”

“The further you go, the stronger the gravity becomes. At this distance, the gravity I’m facing is approximately five to seven times that of a normal planet.”

The burly man announced openly.

He wasn’t lying, because the other Evolvers would quickly realize the same truth with just a little testing.
